note: Each claim of the lemma has a declaration: width and placement independence, commutativity, cyclic and separating vacuum, separability (B12.answer, which supplies the dense sequence that resolution assumes), compact metric spectrum with full-support probability measure, and the mixture formula. [L] states them separately under hierarchy, steadiness and rotation hypotheses that [M] establishes earlier in the same proof.
